2026_primary.fact: Wayback capture 2026-03-04 00:29:55 CST (election night) of 'March 3 2026 Republican Party Cumulative Unofficial.pdf' (wayback-data Upshur/2026_primary_20260304062955_3b13c3086245.pdf): 13-page 'Republican Party Cumulative Upshur County Unofficial Results 2026 PRIMARY ELECTION March 3, 2026 Primary Precincts Reporting 19 of 19 = 100.00% Run Time 9:34 PM 3/3/2026 Run Date 03/03/2026', PDF CreationDate 2026-03-04 03:34:45 UTC (9:34 PM CST), county totals by Absentee, Early and Election Day Voting only (for example 'KEN PAXTON 54 33.13% 1,689 48.90% 1,479 47.68% 3,222 47.95%'). The Democratic twin was also archived at 00:29:09 CST but its replay failed. The harvest's CDX query for countyofupshur.com election/result/precinct/canvass/cumulative URLs from 7 PM to 3 AM returned only these two cumulative files. The county's Elections page now lists for this primary only the 'Cumulative Official' reports (Run Date 03/11/2026) and no precinct report of any kind. Rule 43: county totals on election night and nothing shows precinct numbers posted that night (no precinct report for this primary is posted).
